parameters.name: BindedInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance with which you want to associate the EIPs.

The instance can be a NAT gateway or a secondary ENI.

parameters.name: BindedInstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the instance with which you want to associate the EIPs. Valid values:

*   **Nat**: NAT gateway
*   **NetworkInterface**: secondary ENI

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate a token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **request ID** as the **client token**. The **request ID** may be different for each request.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description:
The EIPs to be associated with the instance.

You must enter at least one EIP. You can enter up to 50 EIPs.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
The association mode. Set the value to **MULTI_BINDED**, which specifies the Multi-EIP-to-ENI mode.

This parameter is required only when **BindedInstanceType** is set to **NetworkInterface**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region to which the EIPs belong. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc associate-eip-address-batch --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --binded-instance-id ngw-hp3akk9irtd69jad0000 --binded-instance-type Nat --biz-mode MULTI_BINDED --instance-ids eip-2zeerraiwb7ujsxdc0000 --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0016e04115b --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc AssociateEipAddressBatch --region cn-hangzhou --BindedInstanceType Nat --Mode MULTI_BINDED --BindedInstanceId 'ngw-hp3akk9irtd69jad0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0016e04115b' --InstanceIds.1 'eip-2zeerraiwb7ujsxdc0000'
